title: What is SAP BTP?
summary: The platform layer where you build, integrate, extend, and operate intelligent enterprise apps beside SAP systems of record.
explain:
SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is SAP’s cloud platform for application development, integration, data & analytics, automation, and AI — typically used beside S/4HANA and other systems of record.

Think of three layers:
1) Systems of record (S/4, success factors, etc.) hold core business truth.
2) BTP is the innovation & integration layer: APIs, events, extensions, data products, workflows, AI assistants.
3) Experience layer: Fiori, Work Zone, analytics stories people actually click.

BTP is not “one app.” It is a set of services you entitle in accounts and assemble into landscapes. Fidelity: conceptual Tier 1–2 — always verify current commercial names in official SAP docs.
analogy: If S/4 is the bank vault of business truth, BTP is the modern branch network + digital apps built around the vault without drilling holes in the vault walls (clean core).
whyItMatters: Newcomers who skip this step jump into CAP/RAP tools without knowing why the platform exists — and design random microservices that fight the system of record.
formalPoints: BTP is a multi-service platform (build, integrate, automate, data, AI), not a single product
Used mainly for side-by-side extension and integration with systems of record
Landscapes are assembled from accounts, entitlements, and services — not installed as one monolith
Clean-core strategy: extend without modifying SAP standard where possible
commonMistakes: Treating BTP as a replacement for S/4 instead of a complementary platform
Starting with a random service (CAP, CPI, BPA) without a business capability map
Assuming every workload must run on BTP
howToRecognize: Someone asks ‘where do we build the new approval app?’ or ‘how do we integrate partners?’
howToApply: State the business capability first, then map to BTP service categories
Draw system of record vs platform vs experience in one slide

glossary.definition: Authoritative system for a business object (often S/4 for finance/logistics).
Build new capability next to the core system using APIs/events, not by changing core code.

mnemonic: VAULT + BRANCHES: S/4 is the vault; BTP is the modern branches around it — don't demolish the vault.
useCases: Landing zone setup week: apply What is SAP BTP? so Dev/Test/Prod don't share blast radius.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “What is SAP BTP?” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “What is SAP BTP?”.
